name: Playground
spec: yellow diamond with a black child-on-swing symbol
meaning: A playground is nearby; watch for children.

snippets.back: Disobeying official traffic controls in a school zone, playground, crosswalk or park is assigned six points.
Near schools, playgrounds, and residential streets, reduce speed and watch for children entering the roadway.
Scan for cars, motorcycles, bicyclists, people and animals that may cross your path, especially at intersections, crosswalks, shopping centers, construction areas and playgrounds.
Slow zones calling for lower speed and extra attention include shopping centers, schools, parks and playgrounds, residential streets, rush hour, narrow bridges, toll plazas and rail crossings.
Green guides to places, roads and distances, glowing yellow-green guards walkers, riders and pupils, blue guides to roadside services and brown to parks and playgrounds.
Playgrounds, schools, children, narrow or winding roads and pedestrian hazards require lower speeds.
A playground warning calls for caution because many children may be present.

Be especially watchful for children near schools, parks, playgrounds and residential areas, stop on the signal of any school crossing guard, and the law requires watching for pedestrians when turning at intersections and when entering or leaving driveways.
